description: Driver's FP2 best long-run intercept minus session median (sec). Negative = faster than session median. Proxy for race pace potential.
Slope of LapTime ~ LapNumber for driver's best FP2 long-run stint (sec/lap). Positive = tyre deg; near-zero = consistent. Proxy for race strategy.
Number of laps in driver's qualifying FP2 long-run stint (0 if no long run). Proxy for how seriously driver ran race simulation in FP2.
